rules.sentence: When `LK-BALANCE` is at most zero, it sets `LK-MINIMUM` to zero and returns to its caller.
When `LK-BALANCE` is more than zero and `LK-BALANCE` is at most `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, it sets `LK-MINIMUM` to `LK-BALANCE` and returns to its caller.

When `LK-BALANCE` is more than zero, `LK-BALANCE` is more than `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, and `LK-MINIMUM` is less than `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, it computes `LK-MINIMUM` as `LK-BALANCE / 50`, sets `LK-MINIMUM` to `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, and returns to its caller.
When `LK-BALANCE` is more than zero, `LK-BALANCE` is more than `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, and `LK-MINIMUM` is at least `PAYMENT-FLOOR`, it computes `LK-MINIMUM` as `LK-BALANCE / 50` and returns to its caller.
